subject: statistics: batch update the stats meta and skip updating stats meta history. (#60595)
summary: Reviewed the statistics changes in this commit (diff vs first parent): `storage.SaveMetaToStorage` switches from `REPLACE INTO mysql.stats_meta` to a batched `INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE`, which avoids clobbering `snapshot` and preserves `last_stats_histograms_version` when `refreshLastHistVer=false`. The `StatsReadWriter.SaveMetaToStorage` API is updated accordingly and covered by a new integration test. No Blocker/High correctness, data-consistency, concurrency, or SQL-semantics issues found in the statistics scope.
